result.title: GUI-WEdit and GUI-SkillEvo: Gradient-Free Adaptation of Small GUI Agents
result.summary: Small graphical user interface (GUI) agents can execute desktop workflows, but repeated local errors and fragile procedural decisions limit their reliability. We present GUI-WEdit-4B and GUI-SkillEvo-2B, two gradient-free adaptations of GUI-Owl-1.5 backbones. For the 4B model, we use trajectory feedback to construct guarded, closed-form updates to a late multilayer perceptron (MLP), retaining successful states as protection constraints. The final checkpoint changes 23,739,095 parameter values, or 0.535\% of the 4,437,815,808-parameter backbone, within one weight tensor. For the 2B model, an assistant iteratively proposes and refines procedural skills while the model weights remain fixed. On the 361-task OSWorld subset excluding Google Drive tasks, the frozen systems obtain final aggregate scores of 48.02\% and 45.47\%, respectively.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作提出两种免梯度适配小型 GUI agent 的方案：4B 模型根据轨迹反馈对一个靠后 MLP 做带保护约束的闭式权重编辑（仅改动单张量约 0.535% 参数），2B 模型则在冻结权重下由助手迭代生成并精炼流程性技能，在 OSWorld 子集上分别取得 48.02% 与 45.47% 的聚合分数。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用轨迹成败反馈定位并改写局部参数、同时保留成功状态作为约束」的做法，可能与 LVR 中轨迹监督与贡献分配问题相关，可供核查是否能用于 latent 推理状态的训练信号；但原文面向 GUI 动作可靠性，未涉及视觉细节保留或推理期 latent 生成。
